data.name: Saheb
data.gender_notes: Saheb is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who holds or manages a property or business, a leader or a master. The name Saheb carries the meaning “Master, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Saheb usually hope their child will grow to embody master, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who embodies divine qualities and leads others towards spiritual growth
data.etymology: Saheb belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Master, Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saheb total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The Hindu name "Saheb" holds a significant cultural impact in Indian society, especially in regions with a strong Hindu and Marathi influence. It is often used as a title of respect for elders, leaders, and masters. The name conveys a sense of authority, respect, and a high social standing, reflecting the traditional Indian societal structure. It is also common to refer to a deity or a guru as 'Saheb' as a sign of reverence and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name "Saheb" can be seen as a reminder of the divine master or guru who has taken responsibility for guiding us on our spiritual journey. The name can inspire us to seek a deeper understanding of the universe and our place in it by recognizing the existence of a higher power who holds the reins of creation and destiny. The name 'Saheb' can serve as an invitation to submit ourselves to the loving care and guidance of the divine master, reflecting the Hindu belief in God as the ultimate authority and guide.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Saheb: Master, ruler, or respected figure in one's life. The prefix 'Sa' signifies 'great' or 'supreme' while 'heb' means 'master' or 'lord'. This name signifies reverence, respect, and acknowledgement of someone as a superior figure or guide.
